name: Inui Takahito
source: He manages the Kojiya Flower Shop where Sojin works and is also Sojin's benefactor, having taken him in after his war injury. He used to be a Shinto priest but prefers not to discuss his past. He's so handsome that everyone envies him, and his fragile, sickly-looking appearance makes him popular with women. In reality, he is in perfect health except for his unfortunate liver.
